Description.description: One pass of a checklist over a case by one review type. A single table carries Tax and AQS through al_ReviewType rather than two tables. FR-010, BR-004.

Portal identity of the checker this review instance is assigned to (AD-047). Set server-side at assignment from the work-email join (OD-003, AD-010). Power Pages table permissions resolve through Contact relationships and cannot read ownerid, so this is what Contact-scoped access binds to; systemuser ownership is unchanged and remains the Dataverse security gate.
The checklist version issued to this review instance, frozen at creation. Restrict delete is what stops a version that history depends on being removed (AD-004, BR-013).
Short label identifying the review instance in lists and worklists.
The case this review instance belongs to, so a case can list its Tax and AQS checks. Set by the routing command; Restrict delete preserves the review and its responses (BR-012, BR-007).
Stable business code combining the case reference, review type and attempt. Alternate key, so re-running a create is idempotent under NFR-REL-01 and no GUID leaves the platform (AD-014).
Unique identifier for the review instance.
The segment of the canonical case lifecycle that a single review instance passes through.
Lifecycle position of this review instance. Submitted locks the instance and its responses under FR-016; the transition is a server-side command, not a client update (AD-003).
The two review types BR-004 recognises.
Whether this instance is the Tax check or the AQS check. Carrying the type here is what lets one table serve both routes (BR-004).
Position of this instance in the case route. BR-004 requires Tax to precede AQS, so on a Tax-then-AQS route Tax is 1 and AQS is 2.
When the reviewer first opened the instance for editing. Feeds turnaround MI under BR-010.
When the instance was submitted and locked under FR-016. Empty until submission.
